title: Turtle Rock
description: Level: 8 Required: Defeat [Turtle Rock](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-links-awakening/maps/koholint-island?locationIds=56543) (Mini-Boss) Turtle Rock is both the name of this dungeon and the creature block its entrance. Defeat the mini-boss to reveal the opening to the Turtle Rock dungeon.

title: Color Dungeon
description: Level: 0 Required: None Unlike other dungeons where the goal is to find instruments to wake the Wind Fish, the Color Dungeon rewards you with the option to change your tunic and increase one of your stats. Anytime you want to change your tunic color (Red, Blue, or Green), you can return to the Color Dungeon and talk to the [Fairy Queen](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-links-awakening/maps/koholint-island?locationIds=56509). Reward: Blue Tunic (increased defense) or Red Tunic (increased attack)

title: Angler's Tunnel
description: Level: 4 Required: Angler Key After completing the Key Cavern, you can meet Marin on the Toronbo Shores, south of Mabe Village. Link and Marin have a nice moment together, and then Marin becomes a temporary companion! Escort Marin to the Animal Village, where she can wake up the Sleeping Walrus. With the Walrus out of the way, Link can continue into the Yarna Desert and fight [Lanmola](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-links-awakening/maps/koholint-island?locationIds=56407). Defeat the boss to receive the Angler Key. The lock is south of the dungeon entrance, on the raised platform. Use the Angler key on the lock to lower the water level and reveal the Angler's Tunnel entrance.

title: Eagle's Tower
description: Level: 7 Required: Bird Key After completing the Key Cavern, you'll get access to the [Dream Shrine](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-links-awakening/maps/koholint-island?locationIds=56269) and the Ocarina. Afterwards, head south of the Ukuku Prairie to the Pothole Fields and Signpost Maze. Follow the directions of the signs until you find Mamu. Mamu will teach you the Frog's Song of Soul in exchange for 300 rupees. With a new song for your Ocarina, head back to Mabe Village. You may have noticed a bird-shaped weather vein in town, where Marin typically hangs out and sings. Push the bird statue to reveal stairs, which lead you to some rooster bones. Play the Frog's Song of Soul to revive the rooster. Carrying the rooster makes Link fly! With your zombie rooster in tow, make your way to the [Hen House](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-links-awakening/maps/koholint-island?locationIds=53827) in the Tal Tal Mountain Range. Before reaching the [Hen House](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-links-awakening/maps/koholint-island?locationIds=53827), stop by a cave directly south of the [Hen House](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-links-awakening/maps/koholint-island?locationIds=53827) and use the rooster to fly over the chasm to finally pick up the Bird Key. The dungeon's lock is to the left of the cave entrance, behind some boulders. This is easily the most confusing dungeon in the game. The main objective is to throw the iron ball at all four cracked pillars. This is easier said than done. It is _highly_ recommended to follow a video walkthrough to prevent getting lost and endlessly backtracking through the dungeon.

title: Bottle Grotto
description: Level: 2 Requires: BowWow Shortly after completing the [Tail Cave](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-links-awakening/maps/koholint-island?locationIds=53772), Link returns to Mabe Village to find that Moblins have kidnapped BowWow. Rescue BowWow in the Moblin Cave and return him to [Madam MeowMeow](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-links-awakening/maps/koholint-island?locationIds=53793). In return, you can take BowWow for a walk into the Goponga Swamp, where he can eat the Goponga Flowers blocking the dungeon entrance.

title: Tail Cave
description: Level: 1 Required: Tail Key To unlock this dungeon, you must retrieve the Tail Key from the Mysterious Forest. However, when you enter the forest, a raccoon will meddle with the map, ensuring you get lost and never find the key. While you stumble around the Mysterious Forest, you will eventually find a hollow trunk that leads into a cave. Exit out the other side of the cave and pick up the Sleepy Toadstool on the ground. Find the [Witch's Hut](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-links-awakening/maps/koholint-island?locationIds=53809) and trade the Sleepy Toadstool for Magic Powder. Return to the Mysterious Forest and throw the Magic Powder at the raccoon. Now, you can navigate the north side of the Mysterious Forest and find the Tail Key in a chest.

title: Key Cavern
description: Level: 3 Required: Slime Key Prince Richard currently has the Slime Key needed to open the Key Cavern. He can be found at [Richard's Villa](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-links-awakening/maps/koholint-island?locationIds=53813), where he has taken up residence since fleeing Kanalet Castle. He agrees to give you the Slime Key in exchange for five Golden Leaves from Kanalet Castle. The bridge to Kanalet Castle is being guard by Kiki. If you give [Bananas](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-links-awakening/maps/koholint-island?locationIds=53834) to Kiki, he'll let you pass.

title: Face Shrine
description: Level: 6 Required: Face Key, Bow & Arrow You probably already have the bow at this point in the game, but if not, head to the [Mabe Village Shop](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-links-awakening/maps/koholint-island?locationIds=53799) and purchase a bow for 980 rupees. Next, you need to find the Face Key to unlock the gate to the dungeon. North of the Face Shrine, you can find the Ancient Ruins. The Ancient Ruins are filled with Armos, stone enemies that come alive when Link touches them. The easiest method to defeat an Armos is drop a bomb, and just as the bomb starts flashing red, touch the Armos, and run away. If you time it correctly, the bomb will explode and kill the Armos just as it wakes up. You only need to defeat the Armos that block your path to the Ancient Ruins temple. Inside the temple, you will find a mini-boss: the Armos Knight. The Armos Knight will chase you around the room, jumping and slamming the ground to try and stun Link. Use the Roc's Feather to jump just as the Armos Knight starts to fall to avoid the stun attack. As you attack the Armos Knight, his weapons and armor will fall off and he'll become easier and easier to attack. When the Armos Knight is finally defeated, pick up the Face Key.

title: Catfish's Maw
description: Level: 5 Required: Flippers from [Angler's Tunnel](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-links-awakening/maps/koholint-island?locationIds=53769) To enter Catfish's Maw, swim in Martha's Bay to the southeast corner of the giant stone catfish, near the cluster of rocks. Dive underwater to enter a 2D view where you can now swim through a hidden underwater path. When you surface on the other side, Link will be in the center of the rock cluster near the entrance of Catfish's Maw.

title: Wind Fish's Egg
description: Level: 9 Required: [Magnifying Glass](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-links-awakening/maps/koholint-island?locationIds=53844) In order to navigate the Wind Fish Egg, you need to use the [Magnifying Glass](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-links-awakening/maps/koholint-island?locationIds=53844) to read the mysterious book at the [Mabe Village Library](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-links-awakening/maps/koholint-island?locationIds=53852). The [Magnifying Glass](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-links-awakening/maps/koholint-island?locationIds=53844) is the final item in the Trading Sequence quest. The pattern to navigate the Wind Fish is randomized for each game save, so it's important to learn the pattern from the library book. Write it down or take a screenshot to reference later. Outside the Wind Fish Egg, use the Ocarina to play the Ballad of the Wind Fish. Proceed to the final dungeon and the final boss fight!

description: Required: Power Bracelet Lift the boulder to reveal the entrance to Mad Batter’s altar. Sprinkle Magic Powder to awaken the Mad Hatter. In return, he'll "curse" you with an increased carry capacity for magic powder.

title: Mad Batter
description: Required: Roc's Feather, Pegasus Boots, Flippers Clear the grass near the altar entrance using either bomb or boomerang, then long jump (Roc's Feather + Pegasus Boots) across the holes in the ground. Go down the stairs and use the Flippers to cross the underground water. On the other side of the water is a staircase, use it to return above ground and walk straight to reach a third stairwell—this will finally lead you to the Mad Batter. Sprinkle Magic Powder on the altar to wake the Mad Batter. In return, he'll "curse" you with an increased carry capacity for bombs.

title: Trendy Game
description: _10 rupees per game_ You'll be able to access the Trendy Game after finding Link's sword and clearing away the tall grass. New prizes will be available every time you complete a new dungeon. Keep in mind, new items won't appear until you've won the old ones. Below is the chronological appearance of special prizes: 1: Yoshi Doll (Trading Sequence #1) - After first visit to the Mysterious Forest 2: Heart Piece #1 - Exit & enter the shop after obtaining the Yoshi Doll 3 : Secret Seashell #1 - Exit & enter the shop after obtaining Heart Piece #1 4: CiaoCiao Figure - Exit & enter the shop after obtaining Heart Piece #1 & giving the Ribbon to CiaoCiao for Trading Sequence #3 5: Goomba Figure - Completion of Tail Cave 6: Spiny Figure - Completion of Bottle Grotto 7: Chamber Stone #1 - Completion of Bottle Grotto 8: Heart Piece #2 - Completion of Key Cavern 9: Boo Figure - Completion of Key Cavern 10: Secret Seashell #2 - Completion of Angler's Tunnel 11: Cheep Cheep Figure - Completion of Angler's Tunnel 12: Blooper Figure - Completion of Catfish's Maw 13: Shy Guy Figure - Completion of Face Shrine 14: Piranha Plant Figure - Completion of Eagle's Tower 15: Pokey Figure - Completion of Turtle Rock 16: BowWow Figure - Completing the game (beating Nightmare & saving after the credits roll; star will be next to the save file) 17: Chamber Stone #2 - After collecting all 10 Figures the Trendy Gamester will give Link the second Chamber Stone Note: After collecting all 10 Figures the cost of playing the game will be cut in half to 5 Rupees.

title: Fishing Pond
description: Requires: _10 Rupees per game_ Talk to the Fisherman by the pond to try your hand at the fishing game. The minigame's three "special" catches become available after completing [Catfish's Maw](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-links-awakening/maps/koholint-island?locationIds=53775) (Cheep Cheep and Blooper) & the [Face Shrine](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-links-awakening/maps/koholint-island?locationIds=53774) (Ol' Baron). Lightweight Lure is best used when trying to catch Little Fish & small Cheep Cheep at the surface of the pond. The Middleweight Lure is received as a reward for catching a Big Fish for the first time. It descends faster to the middle than the Lightweight or heavyweight Lures. This is the best lure to use when trying to catch Big Fish & Bloopers in the middle of the pond. The Heavyweight Lure is received as a reward for catching a Blooper for the first time. It descends faster to the bottom than the Lightweight or Middleweight Lures. This is the best lure to use when trying to catch Big Fish & Ol' Baron at the bottom of the pond.

title: Chamber Dungeon
description: Dampé and the Chamber Dungeon are new additions to the Nintendo Switch remake of Link's Awakening. The Chamber Dungeon minigame lets you assemble Chamber Stones (room pieces) to create custom dungeons. To find Chamber Stones, complete minigames, complete dungeons, or purchase them from shops.

title: Rapids Raid
description: _100 rupees per game_ The Rapids Race is a water-based obstacle course you navigate by following current lines and a hookshot. Your rewards are based on how quickly you can finish the obstacle course. The finish line is the waterfall south of the rapids. Rewards: - Under 40 Seconds — Heart Piece - Under 35 Seconds — Secret Seashell - Under 30 Seconds — Chamber Stone

title: Moldorm
description: _Dungeon Boss_ To damage Moldorm, hit the glowing red orb at the end of its tail. When you hit it, Moldorm will frantically move around the room and attack you. Be careful around the room's corners—Moldorm can push you into the holes, forcing you to navigate back to the Boss Room and restart the fight. Reward: Heart Container

title: Spike Roller
description: _Mini-Boss_ Use the Roc's Feather to jump over and avoid the spike pole that will roll across the room. Hit the Spike Roller with your sword.

title: Hinox
description: _Mini-Boss_ The Hinox will throw bomb and charge at you, all in an attempt to grab and throw you for massive damage. Lure the Hinox to charge at you, but dodge so it hits the wall instead. The Hinox will stumble, giving Link an opportunity to do some damage.

title: Genie
description: _Boss_ To damage the Genie, dodge the fireballs until you can get next to the Genie and hit him. When the Genie retreats into his bottle, use the [Power Bracelet](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-links-awakening/maps/koholint-island?locationIds=54046) to throw it. After three throws, the bottle will break. The Genie's fireball attack will change; now he goes transparent and then will randomly appear to throw one, massive fireball at Link. Dodge the fireball and get close to the Genie to land some hits. Reward: Heart Container

title: Dodongo Snakes
description: _Mini-Boss_ Dodongo Snakes open their mouth every time they move forward. Throw a bomb in front of them just before they move, and the snakes will eat the bomb. Don't try to immediately feed them a bomb again; the snakes need to move three blocks before they will eat another bomb.

title: Slime Eye
description: _Dungeon Boss_ Every time you attack Slime Eye's eye, he divides further and further. When there nothing left but a small thread connecting the slime halves, use the Pegasus Boots to sever the connection. This create two smaller Slime Eyes. Attack their eyes and defeat the small Slime Eyes to defeat this boss. Reward: Heart Container

title: Master Stalfos #4 (Hookshot)
description: _Mini-Boss_ This is the fourth and last room you fight Master Stalfos. To defeat Master Stalfos, guard with your shield until they swing at you with their sword. When Master Stalfos is recovering, his shield will be down and you can land a few hits. Unlike the other three fights, this time Master Stalfos will also perform a jump attack that will go through Link's shield. When Master Stalfos collapses into a pile of bones, drop a bomb on them. Repeat three times. Master Stalfos will finally be defeated and drop the Hookshot that they stole!

title: Master Stalfos #1
description: _Mini-Boss_ This is the first room you fight Master Stalfos. To defeat Master Stalfos, guard with your shield until they swing at you with their sword. When Master Stalfos is recovering, his shield will be down and you can land a few hits. When Master Stalfos collapses into a pile of bones, drop a bomb on them. Repeat three times.

title: Master Stalfos #2
description: _Mini-Boss_ This is the second room you fight Master Stalfos. To defeat Master Stalfos, guard with your shield until they swing at you with their sword. title: Gohma
description: _Mini-Boss_ This is the "real" mini-boss of Catfish's Maw. The crab-like mini-boss has two primary attacks: a charge attack if Link is nearby, and a long-range fire attack if Link is far away. You want to stay far away and wait for the Gohma to open their eye to shoot fire. Shoot at the open eye with the Hookshot or Bow to stun the Gohma.

title: Slime Eel
description: _Dungeon Boss_ The Slime Eel will burst through the room and create five holes: one hole for his mace-like tail to attack you, and four holes for his head to appear and shoot fire at you. When the Slime Eel appears at one of the wall holes and opens his mouth, use the Hookshot to pull the Slime Eel out of the hole. This will reveal his weak point: the large pink segment of his body. Hit the pink circle before the Slime Eel slowly falls back into the wall hole. Reward: Heart Container

title: Rover
description: _Mini-Boss_ Rover has a large ball that he will throw at Link. Before Rover can pick up the ball, steal it and throw it at him to do damage. Rover cannot be damaged by any other attacks.

title: Facade
description: _Dungeon Boss_ The hardest part of this boss fight is avoiding all the obstacles that Facade throws at Link. Tiles will spin and fly at Link, and Facade will open up a trail of holes in the floor. While avoiding these, do your best to throw bombs on Facade's "face". Reward: Heart Container

title: Dodongo Snakes
description: _Mini-Boss_ The Dodongo Snakes previously appeared in the Key Cavern. This time, you have to contend with holes in the floor while trying to lure the snakes to eat bombs.

title: Hinox
description: _Mini-Boss_ The main attack of this mini-boss is to grab and throw Link. There are also four brasiers in the room that will shoot fire. Stay out of the Hinox's reach and use a long-range attack (bomb, boomerang, bow, hookshot) to deal damage.

title: Grim Creeper
description: _Mini-Boss_ The Grim Creeper will stay on his raised platform and play a flute to summon Battle Bats (flying bombs). You must successfully hit each Battle Bat as it flies towards you without getting hit. If even a single Battle Bat hits you, then you have to start over.

title: Grim Creeper & The Evil Eagle
description: _Dungeon Boss_ During your second encounter with the Grim Creeper, they bring a little more muscle: the Evil Eagle. Use your shield and run against the gusts of wind to protect Link from getting blown off the edge. When the Evil Eagle swoops over Link, use the Boomerang to land a few hits. Reward: Heart Container

title: Lanmola
description: _Overworld Boss_ The Lanmola is a centipede that prowls a quicksand pit in the Yarna Desert. Avoid the center of the quicksand pit while trying to land hits on Lanmola's head. Reward: [Angler Key](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-links-awakening/maps/koholint-island?locationIds=542860)

title: Hydrosoar
description: _Mini-Boss_ The Hydrosaur is an octopus-like enemy that charges down the sides of the room. Use Roc's Feather to jump over the charging enemy, causing it to crash into the wall and be temporarily stunned. Use this opportunity to land a few hits.

title: Angler Fish
description: _Dungeon Boss_ Head down the stairs to enter an underground pool. Swim down to find the boss. Avoid the Angler Fish and falling boulders while Link tries to land a few hits on the glowing orb attached to the boss. The boss will also summon smaller, mini-Angler fish that will swim straight for Link. Reward: Heart Container

title: Giant Buzz Blob
description: _Mini-Boss_ Use Magic Powder to make the green Giant Buzz Blob turn blue. Land a few hits before it turns back to green.

title: Avalaunch
description: _Mini-Boss_ Every time Avalaunch jumps, boulders will fall into the room. Use Roc's Feather to jump and avoid the shockwaves, which would normally stun Link. Dodge the boulders to get close and land some hits on Avalaunch.

title: Hardhit Beetle
description: _Dungeon Boss_ Every time you attack the Hardhit Beetle's shell, it changes color. When the shell turns red, it will finally crack and defeat the boss. Reward: None

title: Turtle Rock
description: _Mini-Boss_ Use the Ocarina to play Frog's Song of Soul to awaken Turtle Rock. The stone turtle head will shake and lunge at Link. When the stone head hits the wall and stuns the creature, throw a bomb. After a few more bombs, the stone will finally crack and reveal the turtle head underneath. From here, it's a normal boss fight: dodge the turtle's attacks and attack the turtle's head with your sword when you have an opening.

title: Blue Hinox
description: _Mini-Boss_ This fight is exactly like the previous red Hinox that you fought, but the Blue Hinox deals more damage and has more health.

title: Spike Roller
description: _Mini-Boss_ This is a repeat of your very first mini-boss from Tail Cave. Use Roc's Feather to jump over the rolling spike pole. Hit the Spike Roller with your sword when you have an opening.

title: Rover
description: _Mini-Boss_ Rover returns with his iron ball. The mini-boss is the exact same as the last dungeon—pick up the iron ball before Rover can reach it, then throw it back at Rover.

title: Blaino
description: _Mini-Boss_ Blaino is a boxing enemy, who attacks with quick jabs or charging punches. After a large charging punch, Blaino will pause for a moment and Link can attack.

title: Hydrosoar
description: _Mini-Boss_ The Hydrosaur will charge along the wall edges like normal, but now Link has very little space to dodge its attacks. Be very careful with your jumps or you may land in the lava. Lure the Hydrosaur to crash into the walls and attack it when it's stunned.

title: Hot Head
description: _Dungeon Boss_ Use the Magic Rod to hit Hot Head with fireballs when it jumps out of the lava. After enough hits, Hot Head will extinguish and become a solid rock that bounces around the room. Use your shield to block the attack. Hot Head will reignite, and you repeat the process with the Magic Rod. Reward: Heart Container
